sets.relationshipLabel: the written plan and the built thing it describes
sets.explanation: A blueprint or script is the document that must exist before the treehouse or play can be built or performed.

sets.relationshipLabel: a tool and the action it exists to perform
sets.explanation: A jump rope exists to be skipped with and a trampoline exists to be bounced on — each toy is defined by its one signature motion.

sets.relationshipLabel: two things defined by touching, where one ends and the other begins
sets.explanation: A curb is the edge where sidewalk meets street, and a porch is the edge where house meets yard — each pair names the seam between two adjacent spaces.

sets.relationshipLabel: two moments facing each other across one span
sets.explanation: The first day of school and reveille mark a beginning, while the last day of school and lights out mark the matching end of the very same stretch of time.
